name: Field
summary: A label, hint, error and one text input, with in-page validation and an error summary.
rungReason: <label for>, constraint validation, aria-describedby and aria-invalid carry everything; an opt-in behaviour (HTML path) or state (React) replaces the browser's bubbles with messages in the page.

messages.source: The first failing ValidityState flag, in the order valueMissing, typeMismatch, badInput, patternMismatch, tooShort, tooLong, rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow, stepMismatch, customError
messages.attributes: data-lue-message-<flag in kebab case> on the control, then data-lue-message, then the browser's validationMessage
messages.style: Say what to do: "Enter your email address", never "Invalid input"

a11y.role: Implicit roles of the label and control; the summary's inner role="alert"
a11y.name: The control's <label>
a11y.description: aria-describedby → hint, then error (the error's "Error: " prefix is visually hidden)

keyboard.action: From the focused summary to its first link, then each link in turn
Focus its control, scrolling its label into view

focus.initial: After a failed submission, the error summary (or the first invalid control when there's no summary)
focus.indicator: :focus-visible outline on controls and the summary

props.label: label text
props.error: message → aria-invalid and the shown error

TextInput.props: every <input> prop; id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid come from the Field

props.title: heading text
props.attempt: changes once per submission; focus follows it

react.rule: React never renders data-lue-validate or data-lue-error-summary; useValidation does the same work with state, using the same controller

enhancements.fallback: A textarea of six lines that scrolls

withoutJavaScript: The browser's own messages appear and block submission; a server-rendered summary (visible, with autofocus) and errors work as written
contrast: Increased contrast: solid boundaries; invalid fields keep a doubled critical boundary
forcedColors: Field / FieldText; invalid controls get a 2 px boundary; the summary uses CanvasText and LinkText
deletionTrigger: Customisable validation messages in the platform (no current proposal)
